FIRSTAMENDMENTTODECLARATIONOFZONINGLOTDEVELOPMENT THIS FIRST AMENDMENT TO DECLARATION OF ZONING LOT DEVELOPMENT (this “Amendment"), made as of Ags+ +, 2023 (the “Effective Date"), byUNION THEOLOGICALSEMINARYINTHECYTY OFNEWYORK,aNewYork not- for-profit education corporation having an address at 3041 Broadway, New York, NY 10027 (UTS"), and BROADWAY COMMUNITY OWNER LLC,a Delaware limited liability company having an address at 200 Park Avenue, 9th Floor, New York, NY 10016 ("Developer"; Developer and UTS, collectively, the “Parties"). RECITALS: WHEREAS, UTS is the owner in fee title of certain land, with the buildings and other improvements thereon as of the Effective Date, located in the Borough of Manhattan, in the City, County and State of New York, known as and by Tax Lot 13 of Block 1992 on the Tax Map of the Exhibit A annexed hereto (said land being herein called the “Lot 13 Land"; said buildings and other improvements, together with any future additions, alterations or replacements thereof, and any facilities or improvements relating thereto, being herein called the “Lot 13 Buildings"; and the Lot 13 Land and Lot 13 Buildings, collectively, being herein called the “Lot 13 Premises"); WHEREAS, Developer is the owner in fee title of certain land located in the Borough of Manhattan, in the City, County and State of New York, known as and by Tax Lot 30 of Block 1992 on the Tax Map, as more particularly described in Exhibit B annexed hereto (said land being herein called the “Developer Land"); WHEREAS, Developer's predecessor-in-interest and UTS declared the Lot 13 Premises and the Developer Land (which, prior to November 19, 2020, was identified as Tax Lots 20 and 30 of Block 1992 on the Tax Map) to be a single zoning lot in that certain Declaration of Zoning Lot Restrictions, dated as of June 22, 2020 and recorded on June 29, 2020 in the Office of the City Register, New York County ("City Register") as CRFN 2020000185038; WHEREAS, Developer's predecessor-in-interest and UTS previously entered into that certain Declaration of Zoning Lot Development, dated as of June 22, 2020 and recorded on June 29, 2020 in the City Register as CRFN 2020000185039 (the“Existing ZLDA"); WHEREAS, the Existing ZLDA took the form of a declaration, rather than an agreement, because UTS executed the instrument in its capacity as owner of both the Lot 13 Premises and the Developer Land; WHEREAS, subsequent to the execution and recordation of the Existing ZLDA, UTS conveyed the Developer Land to Developer; WHEREAS, capitalized terms utilized herein and not defined herein shall have the meanings ascribed to them in the Existing ZLDA; NY79651757v1 07/17/2023 2:03 PM
